message: Last week, we had a surprise power outage that left me rummaging through drawers for flashlights and power banks. Once I got everything set up, I realized how cozy it felt to ditch the screens and play some good old-fashioned board games with my family. We laughed and reminisced as we rolled the dice by lantern light, and it reminded me that sometimes, the simplest moments can be the most joyful. Have you ever had a low-tech night that turned out to be a blast?
